top_stories.title: France Probes Disinformation Campaigns Targeting 2027 Elections
top_stories.summary: French authorities have launched an investigation into disinformation campaigns aimed at influencing the 2027 presidential election. The probe is part of broader efforts to counter foreign interference in European democratic processes.
